name: Revone

surfaces.surface_type: main-window dashboard (marketing composite; app window is the evidence, indigo backdrop+wordmark is brand)
failures: rubric #10 UI contrast — ghost-gray comparison chart series and dim inactive nav icons read <3:1
rubric #14 focus appearance — n/a on a static marketing render
native #3 selection not accent-tinted — home nav selection is neutral-gray inset fill
native #6 accent not bound to selection/focus — indigo used decoratively on chart only
native #9 toolbar-as-tab-bar — main navigation is a centered segmented icon capsule

tokens.notes: near-black canvas; DARKER than kit dark window #1E1E1E — deviates from HIG dark-mode (avoid near-black)
matches macOS 27 system Indigo #6155F5 family, pushed more violet; also the brand-backdrop hue

tokens.value: green ~#34C759 text on ~15% green capsule fill
tokens.notes: '↗ 38%' delta pill; colour paired with up-arrow glyph, not colour-alone
delta pill + nav container fully rounded; matches kit capsule-bezel convention

tokens.value: 2-series smooth spline; primary indigo w/ bloom+gradient fill, secondary ghost-gray; white end-dot + dashed guide; no y-axis/gridlines

patterns.key_values: centered floating icon capsule, 6 monochrome SF Symbols (home/calendar/globe/list/person/gear), selected=inset rounded fill in NEUTRAL gray (not accent-tinted); used as primary navigation (toolbar-as-tab-bar tell)
single floating elevated card, ~20px radius, #242424; date header (bold/secondary), 3 logo+name/value rows with right-aligned tabular values, 1px dividers, Total + Previous-period summary rows
hero KPI block — secondary 'Revenue' label over giant display numeral $4,973 with inline green delta capsule; label whispers, value shouts (label/value hierarchy correct)
breakdown rows: circular token logo + primary name left, bold value right on shared axis; de-emphasised Total/Previous-period

signature_moves: Neon-bloom accent chart — indigo spline with genuine glow/bloom + gradient area-fill on #171717, ghost-gray comparison series behind; no axes/gridlines. The app's whole character in one element.
Centered floating icon-capsule navigation in the title zone instead of a sidebar (compact single-window dashboard identity; also the principal native-tell).
One-accent discipline — sole saturated colours are the indigo chart + one green delta pill; all else a monochrome gray ramp.
defects: Selection grammar deviation — nav selection is neutral-gray inset fill, not system-accent-tinted; accent never binds to selection/focus (native #3/#6).
Toolbar is not a tab bar — top-level nav via segmented icon capsule; HIG routes primary nav to sidebar/tab view; 6 unlabeled icons weaken information scent.
Dark-mode near-black — #171717 canvas deviates from HIG dark base #1E1E1E; mild, reads as cluster trait.
Contrast Dilution (mild) — ghost comparison series & dim inactive icons <3:1 (rubric #10).

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product / dark dashboard (dark neutral ramp + one electric-indigo accent, glow accents, dense-calm layout)

psychology: Von Restorff effect — a single saturated accent (indigo chart + one green delta) against a monochrome ramp makes the data pop; disciplined accent budget.
Hierarchy via de-emphasis / label-value rule — giant $4,973 value dominates while 'Revenue' label whispers; card values bold, secondary rows gray. Correctly applied.
Aesthetic-usability effect — polished dark render buys a perceived-usability halo (marketing intent), forgiveness on first contact.
Information scent (Pirolli–Card) — VIOLATED: 6 unlabeled nav icons force recognition/recall; text or tooltips would strengthen scent.
Data-ink minimalism — chart strips y-axis and gridlines for glanceability, trading precise value-reading for drama.
notes: ONLY input is a marketing composite (no gallery/shots). App window = design evidence; indigo backdrop + white 'All Your Revenue in One Place for macOS' headline + wordmark = brand evidence (brand indigo matches app accent — coherent). It is a scaled ~2x render, so absolute pt sizes are unrecoverable — all sizes are proportional (estimated) with wide ranges; only hex colours are cleanly (measured). Single surface, so every reading is (inferred) — no confirmations. Lineage native at med confidence (SF Symbols + real chrome + SF Pro vs. fully custom skin that a web wrapper could fake). App icon.png present but out of scope for this UI-only digest. Aesthetic is the model-default dark+electric dev-tool look — competent, coherent, but not off-distribution; distinctiveness rests on chart execution.
